description: 19-inch rack-mount shelf, 2U only (there is no 1U version), that holds four cased Raspberry Pis standing on their long edge. It prints as two 241 mm halves that fit a Bambu Lab A1 bed and bolt together with three M4 bolts at the centre split: pi_rack_shelf_2u_pi is the left half, with the four Pi slots and faceplate windows, and pi_rack_shelf_2u_tray is the right half, a plain boxed tray. Each slot fits a case up to 66 x 30 x 94 mm with the Raspberry Pi 4 or 5 port layout (Ethernet and USB-A on one end, USB-C power and micro-HDMI on one long side); the fit is a first-print estimate, adjustable with pi_fit. Each Pi's Ethernet and USB-A end faces out through its own tall faceplate window, and the open top leaves the cable side clear for right-angle plugs.

hardware.notes: Per shelf: two at the front, one at the rear of the split joint
Under each bolt head, on the left half's flange
Pressed into the traps in the right half's flange
A 2U shelf has eight ear slots, use at least four

printing_notes: Print every half floor-down exactly as exported, without supports. Both halves are 241.3 mm wide, leaving about 7 mm each side on a 256 mm A1 bed.
Press the three M4 nuts into the right half's flange traps before fitting the Pis, then bolt the halves together from the left with washers under the heads.
Shared parameters (face_t, floor_t, box_wall_h and anything else set on both halves) should match on both halves; the bolt positions are fixed so the halves always line up.

Each Pi stands on its long edge in its own slot with the Ethernet end against the faceplate window and the cable side (USB-C power, micro-HDMI) facing up. The top is open, with about 19 mm of headroom above the case: enough for right-angle plugs, whose bodies stand only a few millimetres proud of the case. The library asserts at least 15 mm.

The slots fit a generic 66 x 30 x 94 mm case, and the port window sill and inset are first-print guesses: check the fit, then adjust pi_fit, window_sill or window_inset. The rear wall has a cable notch and two vent slits per slot.
